ascend.section: Cloud-Based Dental EHR Integration with Adit
ascend.ctx: Our cloud-based Dental EHR integration synchronizes data from the client's EHR system to the Adit application using a Google Chrome extension. The Chrome extension serves as the real-time synchronization agent. It monitors Create, Update, and Delete (CRUD) operations performed within the EHR and securely transmits these changes to the Adit application. For real-time synchronization to function correctly, the Chrome extension must be installed on every workstation where practice staff, providers, or other users access the EHR and perform data modifications. In cloud-based EHR environments, each computer or device used to access the EHR is referred to as a workstation.

ascend.section: Backup Synchronization
ascend.ctx: To ensure data consistency, the system includes a backup synchronization mechanism that identifies and synchronizes any changes missed during real-time synchronization. While this process helps keep the data consistent between the EHR and Adit, it does not provide immediate updates. Therefore, to achieve complete and real-time synchronization, the Chrome extension should be installed on every workstation where users access and update the EHR. ascend.section: Dentrix Ascend Integration Background
ascend.ctx: Initially, Adit had an official integration partnership with Dentrix Ascend. Following the end of that partnership, we transitioned to an RPA-based integration approach that relies on UI automation and API scraping instead of the official integration. Since then, maintaining the integration has been an ongoing challenge. Dentrix Ascend regularly introduces security enhancements and anti-automation measures that can interfere with our synchronization process. ascend.ctx: The Notes section stores all patient-related notes created in both the EHR and Adit. ascend.section: Overview
ascend.ctx: Practice Analytics (PA) data synchronization requires multiple API calls to the EHR. Frequent API requests can potentially put our application under Dentrix Ascend's monitoring (radar). To minimize this risk, Realtime Sync has been disabled for Practice Analytics, and the data is synchronized only through Backup Sync. We currently support two backup synchronization methods: The Puppeteer-based backup sync updates Practice Analytics data twice a day based on the client's timezone. opendental.ctx: Open Dental is a dental practice management and EHR software used by dental clinics to manage their complete practice operations, including patient records, appointments, clinical charts, treatment plans, billing, insurance, payments, and reporting. Unlike many cloud-based EHR platforms, Open Dental is traditionally known for its locally hosted / client-server architecture, although cloud-hosted deployment options are also available.

Appointment Management Manages provider schedules, operatories, appointment types, confirmations, cancellations, rescheduling and unscheduled appointments. Clinical Charting Maintains tooth charts, procedure history, diagnoses, clinical notes, periodontal examinations and patient conditions. Treatment Planning Tracks proposed procedures, accepted treatment, completed procedures, procedure codes and treatment estimates. opendental.section: 3. Open Dental architecture – How the system works technically
opendental.ctx: This is particularly important when evaluating an integration with Adit. Open Dental traditionally follows a client-server architecture. Open Dental provides three API modes: API mode How it works Local API Communicates locally with Open Dental on the workstation API Service Uses a locally running API service Remote API Uses Open Dental's hosted API service and office eConnector The Remote API requires API enablement, appropriate permissions and a working eConnector.

For Remote API deployments, Open Dental's eConnector facilitates communication between the Open Dental API service and the practice database. The actual integration architecture depends on whether the practice uses local, hosted or remote deployment.

curve.ctx: Curve Dental (commonly called Curve Dental or Curve) is a cloud-based Dental Practice Management System (PMS) designed to help dental practices manage their day-to-day clinical and administrative operations. Unlike traditional desktop-based dental software, Curve operates through a web browser, allowing dentists and practice staff to access patient information, appointments, clinical records, billing, and reports from different locations.
